gloss: to surge; to crowd in; to press forward

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {押|お}し{寄|よ}せませんでした

definitions.gloss: to surge; to rush in; to press forward
definitions.explanation: To move forward in a mass or with force, like waves or a crowd.
For people or things to gather or arrive in large numbers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大波|おおなみ}→大波：25415_oonami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる。
examples.english: Large waves surge toward the shore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高波|たかなみ}→高波：19938_takanami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: High waves surged toward the coast due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せて⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Waves of anxiety came rushing over me one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ステージ→ステージ：11047_suteeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: The audience surged toward the stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せて⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧⟦きれない→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: Orders are flooding in and we can't keep up.

examples.japanese: ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: When the sale started, a huge crowd of customers thronged to the store.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push) + ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to bring near). The compound describes a mass moving toward a point under its own pressure, so the subject is typically a collective or an uncountable force rather than a single person.

USAGE:
Often used to describe:
- ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (waves surging)
- ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (crowd pressing in)
- ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (inquiries flooding in)
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (anxiety welling up)

The verb is intransitive: the thing that surges is marked with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧, and the place it surges toward with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殺到|さっとう}する→殺到：15036_sattou⟧ - to rush in, to flood (more intense, and used only of people, orders, or inquiries — not of waves)
